'''Vinnie Penna''', also known as '''Wayne Grayson''', is an American actor, voice actor, and fight director who works for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Grayson first began to provide voices in {{aniseries|PTS}} during [[S05|the fifth season]]. As with most other voice actors who worked with [[4Kids Entertainment]], he left when {{TPCi|Pokémon USA}} and [[TAJ Productions]] [[Pokémon USA recasting controversy|took over the dubbing and distribution of the series]]. Grayson later returned to the {{pkmn|animated series}} starting with ''[[DP073|Crossing Paths]]''.
